result.rationale:
The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: `contents << "\n
\n#{I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}")}"` interpolates `url` with only the `^https?\://` regex as a gate (no escaping, no URI parse), while poll_feed supplies `url = i.link` straight from the parsed RSS. Post.cook then returns `raw` unmodified for `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, so the injected markup survives to `cooked`, and the embed view renders it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. A single quote or `>` in a link like `http://x/'>
